pairs.subject: embedded-preview
pairs.evidence: crates/server/src/main.rs:368 The bootstrap serves a headless axum JSON/SSE API and hosts no second live application in a frame. A case-insensitive grep of all of crates/server/src for iframe, postMessage, devserver, dev_server, targetOrigin and frame-ancestors found zero hits, so the subject's precondition (a guest app behind its own server, embedded and bridged) does not hold.

techniques.evidence: crates/server/src/registry.rs:7 registry.rs is a name→ScrapeApp table compiled into the binary. It never spawns a guest dev server, so there is no port or process-tree lifecycle to own.
crates/server/src/progress.rs:103 Checkpoints here are scrape-job resume blobs, not per-turn snapshots of a mutated guest project.
crates/server/src/mcp/live.rs:1 The only server→client channel is SSE/JSON-RPC to an MCP client, not a cross-frame bridge to an embedded guest.
crates/server/src/main.rs:362 The server is a plain HTTP listener. No frame message channel exists, so there are no inbound or outbound message origins to validate.
crates/server/src/main.rs:366 No guest application exists to inject an instrumentation agent into.
crates/server/src/main.rs:727 'preview' in this context means a retention dry-run report. No guest route tree is scanned.
